inspections.finding: The initial vav joins directly to a broad filled base. Uneven lower edges do not uniquely distinguish a coalesced bar, pair or other point arrangement from saturation; the ordinary narrow footer proves the extra mass but does not identify its class.

Below a real left-head recession the yod re-expands into a compact additional low-left branch beside the narrower continuing right tail. This filled contour matches the literal same-font pointed/plain pair and filled SUS positive, rather than the ordinary unbranched plain leg.

The complete Daniel yod retains an added low-left compact node after its head inset, with a distinct lower valley between the node and the longer ordinary right tail. Literal pointed controls repeat this branch arrangement; the same-word control pair demonstrates that a plain yod lacks it.

The complete expanded vav shows a broad opaque lower plateau with only very shallow one-pixel notches or lobes. Literal detached bar, pair, vertical dots and qamats arrangements do not survive uniquely in that filled mass, so no expected point is supplied.

The complete yod has a substantial compact lower-left re-expansion after a clear left-head contraction, while its ordinary narrower right tail continues below. The entire filled contour matches the literal pointed local/SUS controls and differs from the single narrow plain leg. A pinhole is not required when the added contour is diagnostic.

The initial vav has a broad low flat plate merged with its shaft. Despite its shallow contour, a degraded fused vowel class remains possible alongside an overinked plateau, and neither a unique point class nor absence is certified.
